settings_policy.scope: A starting point for future I Am Free to Dream recordings. Language and arrangement overrides preserve local musical choices; historical actual settings remain unchanged.

defaults.vocal_gender: Unselected; voice directed in the language prompt
defaults.exclude_styles: EDM, heavy dance beats, aggressive percussion, theatrical belting, excessive vocal runs, vocoder, chopped vocals

settings_policy.exception_rule: Inherit baseline, then adopted language overrides, then adopted language/arrangement overrides. Document changed controls, musical reason, decision reference and review status. Proposed comparisons do not apply automatically. Per-run author directions take precedence and must be recorded. This policy does not authorize generation credits.

entries.title: ମୋତେ ସପ୍ନ ଦେଖିବାକୁ ମନା ନାହିଁ — Bhojpuri Tune Duet
entries.lyrics:
[Intro - Male Lead, Soft Female Responses]
ମୋତେ ସପ୍ନ ଦେଖିବାକୁ ମନା ନାହିଁ
ମନା ନାହିଁ ମଝି ରାସ୍ତାରେ ହଜି ଜିବାକୁ
ଧୃବତାରା ଖୋଜିଦେବ ରାସ୍ତା ।

[Verse 1 - Male Lead, Gentle Female Answers]
ସାଉଁଟି... ସାଉଁଟି...
ଜାବୁଡି ଧରିଛି ସଂସାରକୁ
ଜୋଡି ଦେବାର ଆଶାରେ,
ସଜେଇ ଦେବାର ଆଶାରେ ।

[Verse 2 - Male Lead]
କୁଂଭକାର ମୁଁ ।

ଗଠିଦେବା ସିଖିଛି
ରଂଗେଈ ଦେଈ,
ତୁମ ମୁଖରେ ହସ ବୁଣିବା ସିଖିଛି ।

[Chorus - Male Lead, Soft Female Harmony]
ମୋତେ ସପ୍ନ ଦେଖିବାକୁ ମନା ନାହିଁ
ମନା ନାହିଁ ମଝି ରାସ୍ତାରେ ହଜି ଜିବାକୁ
ଧୃବତାରା ଖୋଜିଦେବ ରାସ୍ତା ।

[Bridge - Female Solo]
ଆସ ପାହାଡ ଚଢିବା
ଆସ ଜନ୍ହ ଦେଖିବା
ବାଦଲ ସାଂଗେ କାଂଧ ମିଳେଈ
ଝଡିବାର ମଂତ୍ର ସିଖିବା ।

[Final Chorus - Male and Female Duet]
ମୋତେ ସପ୍ନ ଦେଖିବାକୁ ମନା ନାହିଁ ।
ମନା ନାହିଁ ଗୁଂଥିଦେବାକୁ
ତୁମ ସପ୍ନକୁ ମୋ ସପ୍ନରେ ।

[Soft Outro - Both Voices, Tender Close Harmony]
ମନା ନାହିଁ ଗୁଂଥିଦେବାକୁ
ତୁମ ସପ୍ନକୁ ମୋ ସପ୍ନରେ ।
entries.style: Sing the supplied Odia lyrics to the reference song, closely following its melody, rhythmic feel, arrangement and playful male-female exchanges. Purabi-inspired acoustic folk duet ballad with soft dholak swing, expressive sarangi replies and quiet harmonium. Warm youthful male lead from the opening, light affectionate female answers; female solo invitation verse, then close-harmony final refrain and outro. Clear natural Odia pronunciation and complete words; fit syllables gently to the tune. Keep the reference’s relaxed phrase endings, restrained ornamentation and gentle kajri-like lilt. Calm soulful joy and playful togetherness at an unhurried pace. Breathe between ସାଉଁଟି... ସାଉଁଟି...; pause fully after କୁଂଭକାର ମୁଁ with instruments sustaining beneath. Let the invitation bloom without accelerating. Use only the supplied Odia words. Peaceful, hopeful ending.
